challenge.content: To complement their extensive retail footprint, SAQR needed a modern digital presence connecting their web, mobile apps, and store automation systems within a modest budget and timeframe.
challenge.heading: The Challenge

overview.content: A pioneer in music and home video retailing, SAQR currently operates 20 stores across Doha. SAQR as a brand signifies strength and passion and has been at the forefront of bringing the latest in entertainment to Qatar for over 25 years. Many revolutionary gadgets and accessories have made their local debut through SAQR stores.
overview.heading: Client Overview

results.heading: Key Outcomes
highlights: Digitally extended a 20-store retail presence in Doha.
Delivered unified e-commerce web and mobile shopping experiences.
Implemented backend automation to optimize order processing.

solution.content: Delivered an integrated e-commerce ecosystem featuring web and mobile platforms alongside custom backend automation software to streamline retail operations and online order management.
solution.heading: Our Solution

items.solution: We implemented a modern storefront with optimized product discovery, fast PDPs, and a streamlined checkout flow. We improved page speed with optimized media, lazy-loading, and caching best practices. We also added analytics-ready tracking points to measure key funnel actions and iterate quickly.
